signed PG mean与anchor scalar量级不等于梯度方向或支配关系，未测PG/anchor分量不能归因于拉回IL。

allfail_partialNC_can_positive.interpretation: All8 fail strict NC/DAC/TTC,so lower average deficit gets positiveA despite NC.5;no actual feasible alternative is present. In1280observed groups NC.5positive=0.

mixed_conservative_feasible_can_negative.interpretation: Metric-strict feasible but lowEP,not proven objectively safest: binary NC/DAC/TTC do not rank safety margins.

credit_mechanism.allfail_partialNC_positive_A: possible: mean(c)-c for c=mean(1-NC,1-DAC,1-TTC),so NC.5 candidate can have positive A when its totaldeficit is below groupmean; still not strict safety
credit_mechanism.conservative_feasible_negative_A: mixed group feasible: A_raw=1-m/8+EP_i-mean_EP_feasible; negative iff EP deficit exceeds1-m/8. allfeasible m8:EP belowmean negative by design; no extra safety margin ranking among metric-perfect candidates
credit_mechanism.global_std: one populationstd of64rawA from8freshgroups,zero groups included; changes magnitude not sign; source cap5 thereafter
credit_mechanism.mean_reference: beta50 loss is to original frozen IL70 transitionmeans,not KL to oldtheta; scalar kl_loss/PG magnitudes do not identify parameter-gradient attribution;group-centered signed PGmean can be near0 despite nonzero gradient,so larger mean kl_loss is not dominance proof
credit_mechanism.mixed_group_unsafe_positive_A: impossible: unsafe A_safe=-m/8<0,A_EP=0; globalpositive std preserves sign

protocol.canonical_feedback: original rewards, records, score, protocol and readouts unchanged
protocol.cost: c = mean(1-NC, 1-DAC, 1-TTC); indicator deficit, not accident severity
protocol.feasible: f = 1 iff official NC == DAC == TTC == 1
protocol.inner_updates: four source inner updates reuse the same finalized advantage tensor
protocol.loss: source PPO, source local effective mean then equal rank mean, source A cap 5, beta50 IL mean anchor
protocol.mask: exactly all-zero A_raw group has PG mask 0; no direction or new sampling on ties
protocol.normalization: population_std of all 64 fresh A_raw, including zero groups, + 1e-8
protocol.raw_advantage: A_safe + A_EP; each group sums to zero
protocol.safety_advantage: if any f: f-mean(f); else: mean(c)-c
protocol.scope: candidate metric conditioning only; no claim of scene-risk reasoning or safety guarantee

credit_mechanism.runtime_learning_scope: Qwen feature extractor frozen; current action attentionLoRA plus scene/predictive memory trainable,reference IL70 all frozen

findings_zh: 零分全观测持续133、曾出现533、间歇400、复发206；“persistent”仅指当前10个离散观测点。
有界TRAIN采样共1280组，真正成功EP1饱和110组、全fail成本tie1组，不能把PG0统一当没学会。
正A不安全候选共24条，mixed组中为0；只来自全fail相对成本排序。NC0.5正A0条，不能视为已安全。
可行候选获负A的mixed组123个；这是可行集合内部EP与安全margin相加的已知作用，不意味着这些候选客观最安全。
同θTRAIN15已证明：6个部署B1零分场景中3个有SDE可行候选；同时120matched roots有41个ODE可行却被SDE破坏，5个被SDE修复。不能由跨θ历史宣称纯sampler因果。
原IL70起点与冻结reference未换；full103k合法并不代表已遍历。均值reference的拉回方向要PG/anchor梯度分量实测，不能由scalarloss下结论。
24k新完整结果已纳入：91.146974，零分270；相对10k修复51但新增65，其中44来自固定高分队列。原10k零分队列对总分贡献+0.347103，而高分队列损失−0.558873，抵消后总体−0.202918，paired CI跨0。
24k总体TTC均值高于10k而EP更低；固定高分队列的TTC和EP均下降。不能将当前问题简单归为全局过度追求速度；mixed可行负A机制是可检验信用问题，不能据此保证降低EP权重会提升分数。
